Question 3
?

Which of the following gives the line integral ∫C(6x2−y2)ds, where the curve C is the right half of the ellipse 6x2+y2=6, shown above?

a
6∫0πsin⁡2tcos2⁡t+5dt
b
6∫−π/2π/2cos⁡2t5cos2⁡t+1dt
c
∫−π/2π/2sin⁡2t5cos2⁡t+1dt
d
∫0πcos⁡2t5cos2⁡t+1dt
e
6∫−π/2π/2cos⁡2tcos2⁡t+5dt
